dialog.map: GeoJSON/JSON/GeoPackage/ZIP inspect with POST /api/v1/import-packages/inspect, then first ready file imports with POST /api/v1/import-packages and opens /studio/areas/{areaId}?package={id}.
dialog.tables: CSV/XLSX rows open TableImportDialog; retain.ts creates POST /api/v1/cases or checks GET /api/v1/cases/{caseId}; useRetainTable supports existing/create, pins current revision, retains through ingestion sources and opens work/cases/{caseId}/tables/{sourceId}.
dialog.development: Only demoImportEnabled tries inspectDemoFile; a successful profile uses startDemoImport. Failed development inspection currently falls back to direct GIS inspection. Transport implementation remains untouched.

role.check: IngestionController uses PrivateSpatialGuard (reject cross-site); services call localOperatorSubject and enforce source actor. localRequestContext supplies operator from server configuration. No additional screen role or administrator requirement; same boundary as table intake. Runtime subject not inspected.

routes.request: multipart file, format geojson|csv|xlsx, requestKey UUID, expectedWorkspaceRevision >=0; tables selection JSON. Optional source-family revision pair; table provenance.
routes.response: AnySourceProfile: source pins, case/workspace pins; GeoJSON paths, eligibility, featureCount, CRS, geometryTypes, limitations.
routes.limits: Nonempty <=16 MiB; GeoJSON FeatureCollection <=2000; qualified polygon geometry and CRS. API FILE_SIZE, RECORD_LIMIT, SOURCE_PROFILE/UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY messages shown verbatim.
routes.role: configured local operator; matching source actor

routes.response: caseId, items: IntakeItem[] ordered by wave/name

routes.role: configured local operator; matching source actor

routes.request: requestKey, expectedRecipeRevision; plan source/workspace pins, manual_mapping, operations; new_area destination name/namespace or fully pinned existing_area
routes.role: configured local operator; matching source actor

routes.response: AnyMappingReceipt[] ordered by revision (not a single receipt)

routes.role: configured local operator; matching source actor

item.needsAnswer: A placement, not an item state: CA0 returns state probed, placement needs_answer.
item.reason: limitReason returned by IntakeItemSchema; DB limit_reason preserves officer/refusal sentences. CA0 writes No approved layout matches this file. An officer chooses the identifier field.
item.planRef: DB plan_ref stores recipeId,recipeRevision,recipeState,origin memory|teacher|officer and packageId; intakeItem(row) omits it.
item.manifestFacts: item/source/case ids, parent/member path, name,family,format,sizeBytes,sizeClass,wave,state,placement,card,partsPlanned,partsDone,recordsSeen,limitReason,pinnedByOfficer,timestamps. card has CRS state/code, counts nullable, native/EPSG4326 extents, columns/types, geometryTypes, limitations and citations.

events.intake.item: itemId,state,family,format,sizeClass,wave,pinnedByOfficer; no filename, reason, recipe or package
events.tableHook: useTableStream subscribes to channel but reduceFrame filters sourceId and ignores intake.item/target. Batch needs its own reducer/subscription; events only invalidate the manifest, never supply missing record facts.

ca0.author: expectedRecipeRevision 0; plan carries current SourceProfile pins, building.sourceKey from /features/*/properties/doitt_id via literal_identifier@1; building.geometry from /features/*/geometry via geojson_polygon@1; destination new_area with inspection.gis.suggestedTitle and suggestedNamespace.
ca0.kind: MappingPlanSchema requires building.sourceKey and building.geometry: building is the only supported kind, not an arbitrary choice.
ca0.profileChoices: paths expose field inventory and literalIdEligible; no suggestedIdField, suggestedTitle or suggestedNamespace. CA0 reads title/namespace from private source inspection SQL, unavailable to this screen.

stopRuleA.blocked: Resume/propose/approve existing layout and package-area link. No alternate read will be used.

stopRuleA.response: POST .../sources and GET .../sources/{sourceId}/profile, GeoJSON SourceProfile branch
stopRuleA.blocked: Preselected suggestion and destination needed for CA0 authorship. Build read-only field question with unavailable explanation; do not invent namespace or ask an extra question.

decision: Build retention/enrolment, sequential per-file outcomes, batch tray, reason/facts and event refresh. Stop only the missing layout/destination and package-link portions. No server/contracts changes or run folder edits.
